FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: Price Above MA20 with Bullish Momentum Amid Mixed Fundamentals
tldr_points: USD/JPY trades above MA20 with RSI near 63, indicating near‑term bullish bias.
China’s slower credit growth and offshore FX push weigh on the yen, while US geopolitical risk supports the dollar.
Key technical resistance lies near 161.30; stop‑loss placed just below MA20 at 159.70.

FX.comment: Price above MA20 with bullish RSI supports upside.
